eligibility_criteria: For admission in the BBA/BABS/BS programs, the candidate must have completed O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies) and A-levels (minimum 3 Subjects)/12th Grade/Intermediate with minimum 50% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution.

BE Mechatronic For admission in the BE Mechatronic program, the candidate must have completed Intermediate in Pre-Engineering/ Computer Science/ Pre-Medical with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) OR A-levels (minimum 3 subjects) or equivalent with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) and Matric/O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects: English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies) in Science group with minimum 60% marks.

BS Autonomous Systems and Artificial Intelligence For admission to the BS Autonomous Systems and Artificial Intelligence program, the candidates must have completed Intermediate in Pre-Engineering/ Computer Science/ Pre-Medical/ with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) OR A-levels (minimum 3 subjects) or equivalent with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) with a minimum of 50% marks, and Matric / O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies).
Candidates with a DAE qualification are also eligible to apply.

BS (Accounting & Finance) 2.5 years For admission in the BS (Accounting & Finance) 2.5-year program, the candidate must have completed O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies), A-levels (minimum 3 Subjects)/12th Grade/Intermediate with minimum 50% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution and Certificate in Accounting & Finance (CAF) duly verified by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (ICAP).

LLB University of London (Recognized Teaching Centre) To be eligible to register for this LLB program, you must normally be at least 17 years of age and one of the following should be applicable: three subjects at GCE A level (with one A Level at not less than grade D) two subjects at GCE A level, and at least three further subjects at GCSE/ GCE O level (at not less than grade C) three subjects at GCE A level, and one further subject at GCSE/GCEO Level (at not less than grade C) two subjects at GCE A Level, and two further subjects at AS Level.

(Given in the last 3 years) Certificate of Higher Education in Common Law (CertHE) To be eligible to register for this CertHE programme, you must be at least 18 years of age and Intermediate with minimum 55% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution.

Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Development (ECED) For admission in the diploma Early Childhood Education and Development (ECED), the candidate must have completed Intermediate with minimum of 45% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution.

test_pattern: The test is divided into four sections: English (30 marks), General Math (20 marks), IQ/Analytical (20 marks), and Basic Computer Knowledge (30 marks).
pages.raw_text: SZABIST's BS(CS) entrance test is a 90-minute, computer-based exam consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions (MCQs). The test is divided into four sections: English (30 marks), General Math (20 marks), IQ/Analytical (20 marks), and Basic Computer Knowledge (30 marks). English (30 Marks): Tests vocabulary (synonyms, antonyms), grammar, sentence completion, and reading comprehension. General Math (20 Marks): Focuses on basic arithmetic, ratios, percentages, algebra, and word problems. IQ and Analytical Skills (20 Marks): Measures logical reasoning, pattern recognition, and problem-solving. Computer Science (30 Marks): Tests fundamental IT concepts, including basic hardware, software, number systems, and programming logic.

hostel_info: SZABIST University in Clifton, Karachi does not operate its own on-campus student housing.
However, multiple highly-rated private hostels are located within a 5-to-10-minute walk or a short commute from the main campus.
pages.raw_text: SZABIST University in Clifton, Karachi does not operate its own on-campus student housing. However, multiple highly-rated private hostels are located within a 5-to-10-minute walk or a short commute from the main campus. Monthly rents generally range from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 35,000, depending on the room type (AC vs. non-AC) and mess facilities.

eligibility_criteria: For admission in the BBA/BABS/BS programs, the candidate must have completed O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies) and A-levels (minimum 3 Subjects)/12th Grade/Intermediate with minimum 50% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution.

BE Mechatronic For admission in the BE Mechatronic program, the candidate must have completed Intermediate in Pre-Engineering/ Computer Science/ Pre-Medical with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) OR A-levels (minimum 3 subjects) or equivalent with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) and Matric/O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects: English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies) in Science group with minimum 60% marks.

BS Autonomous Systems and Artificial Intelligence For admission to the BS Autonomous Systems and Artificial Intelligence program, the candidates must have completed Intermediate in Pre-Engineering/ Computer Science/ Pre-Medical/ with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) OR A-levels (minimum 3 subjects) or equivalent with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) with a minimum of 50% marks, and Matric / O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies).
Candidates with a DAE qualification are also eligible to apply.

BS (Accounting & Finance) 2.5 years For admission in the BS (Accounting & Finance) 2.5-year program, the candidate must have completed O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies), A-levels (minimum 3 Subjects)/12th Grade/Intermediate with minimum 50% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution and Certificate in Accounting & Finance (CAF) duly verified by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (ICAP).

LLB University of London (Recognized Teaching Centre) To be eligible to register for this LLB program, you must normally be at least 17 years of age and one of the following should be applicable: three subjects at GCE A level (with one A Level at not less than grade D) two subjects at GCE A level, and at least three further subjects at GCSE/ GCE O level (at not less than grade C) three subjects at GCE A level, and one further subject at GCSE/GCEO Level (at not less than grade C) two subjects at GCE A Level, and two further subjects at AS Level.

(Given in the last 3 years) Certificate of Higher Education in Common Law (CertHE) To be eligible to register for this CertHE programme, you must be at least 18 years of age and Intermediate with minimum 55% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution.

Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Development (ECED) For admission in the diploma Early Childhood Education and Development (ECED), the candidate must have completed Intermediate with minimum of 45% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution.
